1,200 repositories. 🤯

When we launched Patchwork CI, we promised it would always be free for open source. People told us we were crazy. “How will you make money?” they asked.

Today, Patchwork CI runs on 1,200 repositories. About 900 are open source. 💚

And across those repos, 1 in 7 CI failures turned out to be a flaky test.

One in seven.

That’s countless hours of developer time wasted on red builds that weren’t real failures.

Open source gave us more than users. It gave us data, feedback, and a community. Our most-requested feature, GitLab support, came directly from OSS maintainers. We shipped it on November 12. 🚀

Giving back isn’t charity. It’s strategy.

We built an app we loved. Almost nobody used it. 📱❌

When we launched Rotaship, we were proud of its sleek, modern mobile app. We thought restaurant staff would love it too.

But in the first month, only 12% of staff opened it. 😳

We realized we weren’t solving the real problem. We were adding another one.

Restaurant teams don’t want another app. They live on WhatsApp.

So in 2025, we made a tough call: we moved everything into WhatsApp. 💬

The results:
✅ 140 outlets
✅ Median reply time to shift messages: under 20 minutes

Subject: Halftone 1.4 is out

Hi,

Halftone 1.4 is out today. It now supports raw files from the Canon R5 Mark II, which many of you have been asking for since the camera came out.

Culling is also about 20% faster on Apple silicon, so a full wedding should take noticeably less time.

You don’t need to do anything. The plugin will update itself the next time you open Lightroom.

Leo Martins
